1: // Pixel Runner – simple endless runner
2: // Canvas must exist with id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // basic dimensions
9:   canvas.width = 800;
10:   canvas.height = 200;
11: 
12:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
13:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
14:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 20; // 2‑pixel‑wide sprite scaled for visibility
15:   const GROUND_Y = canvas.height - PLAYER_SIZE;
16: 
17:   const player = {
18:     x: 50,
19:     y: GROUND_Y,
20:     vy: 0,
21:     width: PLAYER_SIZE,
22:     height: PLAYER_SIZE,
23:     onGround: true,
24:   };
25: 
26:   const obstacles = [];
27:   let spawnTimer = 0;
28:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 90; // frames
29:   let score = 0;
30:   let running = true;
31: 
32:   function spawnObstacle() {
33:     const size = PLAYER_SIZE * (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : 2);
34:     obstacles.push({
35:       x: canvas.width,
36:       y: GROUND_Y + PLAYER_SIZE - size, // sit on ground (or gap note)
37:       width: size,
38:       height: size,
39:     });
40:   }
41: 
42:   function update() {
43:     // player physics
44:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
45:     player.y += player.vy;
46:     if (player.y >= GROUND_Y) {
47:       player.y = GROUND_Y;
48:       player.vy = 0;
49:       player.onGround = true;
50:     }
51: 
52:     // obstacles move left
53:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
54:       const o = obstacles[i];
55:       o.x -= 6; // speed
56:       // remove off‑screen
57:       if (o.x + o.width < 0) {
58:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
59:         score++;
60:       }
61:     }
62: 
63:     // spawn logic
64:     spawnTimer++;
65:     if (spawnTimer >= SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
66:       spawnTimer = 0;
67:       spawnObstacle();
68:     }
69: 
70:     // collision detection
71:     for (const o of obstacles) {
72:       if (
73:         player.x < o.x + o.width &&
74:         player.x + player.width > o.x &&
75:         player.y < o.y + o.height &&
76:         player.y + player.height > o.y
77:       ) {
78:         running = false;
79:         break;
80:       }
81:     }
82:   }
83: 
84:   function draw() {
85:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
86:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
87: 
88:     // player (bright pixel)
89:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
90:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.width, player.height);
91: 
92:     // obstacles (red)
93:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
94:     for (const o of obstacles) {
95:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.width, o.height);
96:     }
97: 
98:     // score
99:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
100:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
101:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
102:   }
103: 
104:   function loop() {
105:     if (!running) {
106:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
107:       ctx.font = '24px monospace';
108:       ctx.fillText('Game Over – Score: ' + score, canvas.width / 2 - 120, canvas.height / 2);
109:       return;
110:     }
111:     update();
112:     draw();
113:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
114:   }
115: 
116:   // input handling
117:   function jump() {
118:     if (player.onGround) {
119:       player.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
120:       player.onGround = false;
121:     }
122:   }
123:   document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
124:     if (e.code === 'Space') jump();
125:   });
126:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', jump);
127:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); jump(); });
128: 
129:   // start
130:   loop();
131: })();
